# Testing: General

The package uses Vitest for unit/audit tests and Node syntax checks. Playwright is declared for browser verification and should be treated according to the presence of committed configuration/specs.

| Surface | Command/location | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unit and audit | `npm test` / `tests/` | Behavior, law, state, UI-adjacent and parameter checks |
| Syntax | `npm run syntax-check` | Parse active JavaScript |
| Build | `npm run build` | Vite production bundle smoke test |
| E2E | `npm run test:e2e` | Browser workflow verification when configured |
| Spec drift | `npm run spec:check` | Byte-for-byte docs/spec contract |

This tree records test surfaces. It does not mark a test green without execution.
